prompt: Create a square, cheerful educational promotional illustration/photo composite showing a cute white humanoid robot mascot at a wooden desk, introducing ChatGPT as an AI assistant created by OpenAI. The robot is centered, with a glossy black rounded screen face, glowing cyan smiling eyes, white plastic body, rounded headphones/ear pods, black joints, one hand holding a white sign and the other hand waving. On the robot chest and sign, include a teal knot-like OpenAI-style logo. The sign reads: “I was created by” above the logo, large “OpenAI”, then “An AI research and deployment company”, and at the bottom “Better AI. A brighter future.” Use a warm classroom/office setting with shallow depth of field, soft natural light, polished wooden desktop, and a dark chalkboard-style background covered with friendly hand-drawn white and mint lettering. On the left chalkboard, write exactly: “Hi there!” then “I’m” then a large mint underlined “ChatGPT”. Add three explanatory doodle items, count exactly 3: a speech bubble icon with “A large language model (AI assistant)”; a lightbulb icon with “I can answer questions, explain things, help you create, solve problems, and much more!”; a heart icon with “I’m here to be helpful, honest, and friendly.” On the right chalkboard, include a large OpenAI logo with the word “OpenAI” and the stacked words “Research / Safety / Useful AI / for everyone”; above the robot add handwritten “That’s me!” with an arrow pointing to the robot. Desk objects, count exactly 4: a stack of 4 books on the left with spines labeled “BETTER QUESTIONS”, “CLEARER ANSWERS”, “MORE HELPFUL TOMORROW”, and a tiny heart on the bottom book; an open laptop in the lower left with the text “Curiosity builds a better world” and a heart on the lid; a white coffee mug on the right reading “Same team. A brighter future.” with a smiley face; and a thin handwritten footer along the bottom edge reading “OpenAI × ChatGPT = More possibilities for everyone” with small decorative rays and a heart. Style should feel like a high-quality 3D render mixed with hand-lettered chalk notes, clean rounded shapes, teal accent color, friendly accessible branding, slight realistic camera blur, no harsh shadows, no extra characters, no watermarks, and keep all text legible.
